label: A lending freeze across American banks
description: Banks across the United States stop lending, so that people cannot get loans for cars, houses or apartments, with cars above fifty thousand dollars named and interest rates and prices falling at the same time. Given 1 November 2024.
aliases: there was a lending freeze in the banks
people were not able to get loans

label: Families go back to the table and to core values
description: After the humbling, people returning to their roots and to core family values, eating at home around the dinner table rather than at fast food chains, in homes he compares to Leave it to Beaver.
aliases: Leave it to Beaver style homes

label: An attack at Sydney Harbour and the Opera House
description: An attack seen on Sydney Harbour at the opera house, warned about and prayed against at a named meeting. Given 15 June 2024.
